slide_sweep.method: Continuous translated AABB enclosure against exact stationary solids; any positive result requires refinement, not automatic collision claim.

constant_profile_checks.meaning: Rail rectangle also contains rail screw heads at bearing heights; full straight screw major cylinder is constant along travel. Motor body lies before moving nut bracket.

shutter_sweep.method: Continuous translated AABB enclosure against exact stationary solids; any positive result requires refinement, not automatic collision claim.

gantry_deck_head_sweep.limit: Full deck routing range preserved. Low-Z movement into ATC bay is excluded and requires its separate tool-change handshake.

conditional_loaded_allocations.hold: Actualmagazine maynotfittheseallocations; supplierdrawing/pocket pitch/endcaps/cover and actualloaded tools remainrequired.

load_screen.limitation: Elastic member-only screens, not joint/frame/rail/tool-loop qualification. Torque about verticalZ is in-plane reaction, not tube longitudinal torsion. Weld HAZ, clamp preload and measured pocket alignment remain required.
